query: select now() as captured_at,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'slate_date',a.slate_date,'pitcher',a.pitcher,'side',a.side,'selection_status',a.selection_status,'locked_at',a.locked_at,'frozen_at',a.frozen_at,'model_k_line',a.model_k_line,'official_book',a.official_book,'official_odds',a.official_odds,'evaluation_proof',a.evaluation_proof)) as rows from public.alternative_pick_selection_state a where a.bundle_id='pregame_alternative_pick_methodology_v2' and a.checkpoint='frozen_pregame' and a.slate_date between '2026-08-15' and '2026-09-03' and a.official_verdict='LEAN' and a.model_k_line in (2.5,3.5) and a.evaluation_proof#>>'{normalized_inputs,model_market_relationship}'='model_fades_favorite' and a.evaluation_proof#>>'{normalized_inputs,quality_gate_level}'='capped'
